sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: There will be a positive surge in your career prospects today. However, this progress may not be in the direction that you expected. Financial opportunities and success will knock at your door, a rare combination of guests. You will also achieve material progress, predicts Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Your emotions are solid, and you feel good, Taurus. At the same time, you may be tongue-tied. Perhaps you have so many thoughts that you don't know how to sort them out, or which to disclose and which to keep hidden.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Persistence pays off while the Moon moves through Aquarius, dearest Taurus. Miraculous breakthroughs bring you closer to hopes and dreams you've been focused on for quite some time. If a lack of progress has triggered doubt, don't accept defeat just yet. The energy you put toward long-term aspirations brings fast rewards, though you might not get everything you want all at once. Celebrate wins as they come, recognizing how minor milestones add up to big achievements. Get organized when Luna and Venus align tonight, establishing solid routines to ensure your life flows smoothly each day.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Cheer up as good time ahead and you will have additional energy. Even if you keep tackling money issues throughout the day, you are likely to attain profits in the evening. Relatives from distant place would contact you today. All you need is to be aware of what is happening around. A sparkling laughter filled day when most things proceed-as you desire.

readings.text: Luck comes to you when you least expect it. It’s better to keep up with your hard work to achieve the targets. Your colleagues may dislike you since they feel you are forcing them to follow your decision. Your flexible attitude will help you get support when you will be in trouble.

In your constant effort to stay grounded and practical with regard to your current work situation, you may have lost touch with the creative, whimsical side of the equation. Use this day to let your mind go. You will find the answers in the clouds.

bits.t: There will be a positive surge in your career prospects today.

readings.text: On the financial front, today is going to be a favourable day for you, as the cosmos will be working in your favour. You are likely to be extremely happy to see your efforts fructifying.

Career activity brings excitement and drama but also a bit of unpredictability this week. Ideas are flying, but you need to monetize one before moving on to the next lest you find yourself with decreased cash flow. A lot is changing there, requiring you to be diplomatic with your attention at this time.

bits.t: Financial opportunities and success will knock at your door, a rare combination of guests.
Even if you keep tackling money issues throughout the day, you are likely to attain profits in the evening.

readings.text: You will try to save your energy today. This will help you give better output at work or in any other area of life. Ganesha feels that you will be controlling your diet today, which too will help maintain good health.

Today's planetary configuration could make you feel a sense of loneliness, as you realize that there are imbalances in the world that you alone cannot change. You may experience a sense of isolation when considering certain health issues. Try to share your thoughts and ideas with supportive friends and family.

bits.t: The energy you put toward long-term aspirations brings fast rewards, though you might not get everything you want all at once.
Cheer up as good time ahead and you will have additional energy.

lucky.remedy: Feed the dogs rotis, bread and other dog-food, and increase the happiness quotient in the family.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Use your ability to evaluate a situation accurately today. Clear up some confusion.
